definitions.explanation: The act of choosing from among alternatives.

examples.japanese: {難|むずか}しい{選択|せんたく}を{迫|せま}られた。
examples.english: I was forced to make a difficult choice.

examples.japanese: {選択|せんたく}{肢|し}が{多|おお}すぎる。
これが{最良|さいりょう}の{選択|せんたく}だと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think this is the best choice.

notes:
{選択|せんたく}する is used as a する-verb meaning "to choose" or "to select."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {選択|せんたく}する (to select, to choose)
- {選択|せんたく}{肢|し} (option, alternative)
- {選択|せんたく}の{余地|よち} (room for choice)
- {選択|せんたく}{科目|かもく} (elective subject)
- {選択|せんたく}を{迫|せま}られる (to be forced to choose)

HOMOPHONE NOTE:
{選択|せんたく} (selection) vs {洗濯|せんたく} (laundry) - same reading, different kanji and meaning.
